titre: Devoir de synthèse n°3 - Anglais (3ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Respect for the elderly is an important value that seems to be disappearing in modern societies. In the past, old people were respected and cared for by their families. Grandparents lived with their children and grandchildren, sharing their wisdom and experience. Today, however, life has changed. Many young people are too busy with work and technology to spend time with their grandparents. In some countries, old people are sent to retirement homes, where they often feel lonely and forgotten. This is very sad, because the elderly have given us so much and deserve our love and gratitude. We should never forget that one day we will be old too. Taking care of our parents and grandparents is not only a duty; it is a sign of a civilised and humane society.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) How were old people treated in the past?   (2 marks)
2) Why do many young people not spend time with their grandparents today?   (2 marks)
3) How do old people often feel in retirement homes?   (2 marks)
4) Why should we take care of the elderly, according to the writer?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "should": We ______ take care of our parents and grandparents.   (1,5 marks)
2) Put into the passive: "Their families cared for old people."   (2 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "remember" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Complete with a linker (however / because): In the past old people were respected; ______, life has changed today.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Why should we respect and take care of the elderly?" Write a composition (about 10-12 lines) giving your opinion, with arguments and examples. Use linkers.
